indications_and_usage: Uses Temporarily protects and helps relieve minor skin irritation and itching due to: ●Eczema ●Rashes
warnings: Warnings For external use only. When using this product ● do not get into eyes. Stop use and ask a doctor if ● condition worsens ● symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
